task: Fix BatchOperationEngine.test.ts line 180 UUID template literal type error
error_before: src/engines/BatchOperationEngine.test.ts(180,61): error TS2322: Type 'string' is not assignable to type '`${string}-${string}-${string}-${string}-${string}`'.
root_cause: vi.spyOn(crypto, 'randomUUID').mockImplementation was returning Math.random().toString() (plain string), but TypeScript's lib.dom.d.ts types crypto.randomUUID() as returning the UUID template literal type. The mock return value must match the typed signature.
fix_applied: Cast the return value to the UUID template literal type using `as `${string}-${string}-${string}-${string}-${string}` so the mock satisfies crypto.randomUUID's typed return without changing test behavior (history cap logic depends only on entry count, not on UUID contents).
